pr_title: ddl: drop placement rule cache when droping database
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

close #22364

Problem Summary: `drop database xx` statements won't drop placement rules accordingly. 

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test
- Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

```
mycli -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000 -u root --no-warn << "EOF"
set global tidb_enable_alter_placement=on;
drop database if exists test;
create database test;
EOF

mycli -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000 -u root --no-warn << "EOF"
set global tidb_enable_alter_placement=on;
create table test.t1 (a int) partition by hash(a) partitions 2;
alter table test.t1 alter partition p0 alter placement policy role=leader;
EOF

pd-ctl config placement-rules show // the leader rule should show

mycli -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4000 -u root --no-warn << "EOF"
drop database test;
EOF

pd-ctl config placement-rules show // only the default rule
```

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- drop database statements will drop placement rules of the database, its tables, and partitions of tables.

issue_context.title: ddl: drop placement rule cache when droping database
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

It's a part of the project "Placement rules in SQL"(https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/projects/49).

### Background

When dropping a database, the placement rules on it, its tables, and partitions of its tables should be dropped.

### Solutions

Databases can not be recovered, so just directly notify PD to delete rules. `ApplyDiff` should handle rule cache synchronization.
